title: Firm‐to‐Firm Trade: Imports, Exports, and the Labor Market
title_zh: 企业间贸易：进口、出口与劳动力市场
title_primary: 企业间贸易：进口、出口与劳动力市场
title_secondary: Firm‐to‐Firm Trade: Imports, Exports, and the Labor Market
authors: Jonathan Eaton, Samuel Kortum, Francis Kramarz
abstract: Customs data reveal the heterogeneity and granularity of relationships among buyers and sellers, showing how more exports to a destination break down into more firms selling there and more buyers per exporter. We develop a quantitative general equilibrium model of firm‐to‐firm matching that builds on this insight to separate the roles of iceberg costs and matching frictions in gravity. In the cross section, we find matching frictions as important as iceberg costs in impeding trade, and more sensitive to distance. Because domestic and imported intermediates compete directly with labor in performing production tasks, our model also fits the heterogeneity of labor shares across French producers. Applying the framework to the 2004 expansion of the European Union, reduced iceberg costs and reduced matching frictions contributed equally to the increase in French exports to the new members. While workers benefited overall, those competing most directly with imports gained less, even losing in some countries entering the EU.
abstract_zh: 海关数据揭示了买卖双方关系的异质性和颗粒度，显示对某一目的地的出口增长如何分解为更多企业在该地销售以及每个出口商拥有更多买家。我们构建了一个企业间匹配的量化一般均衡模型，基于这一洞察，将冰山成本与匹配摩擦在引力模型中的作用分离开来。在横截面分析中，我们发现匹配摩擦在阻碍贸易方面与冰山成本同等重要，且对距离更为敏感。由于国内和进口中间品在生产任务中直接与劳动力竞争，我们的模型也拟合了法国各企业劳动份额的异质性。将该框架应用于2004年欧盟扩张，冰山成本的降低与匹配摩擦的减少对法国向新成员国出口增长的贡献相当。尽管工人整体受益，但与进口竞争最直接的工人获益较少，甚至在部分加入欧盟的国家中遭受损失。

title: Long-run Effects of Universal Pre-Primary Education Expansion: Evidence from Argentina
title_zh: 普及学前教育扩张的长期效应：来自阿根廷的证据
title_primary: 普及学前教育扩张的长期效应：来自阿根廷的证据
title_secondary: Long-run Effects of Universal Pre-Primary Education Expansion: Evidence from Argentina
authors: Samuel Berlinski, Guillermo Cruces, Sebastian Galiani, Fabian Gonzalez
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the long-run effects of a large public expansion of pre-primary education in Argentina. Between 1993 and 1999, the federal government financed the construction of new preschool classrooms targeted to departments with low baseline enrollment and high poverty, creating roughly 186,000 additional places. We link administrative records on classroom construction to four population censuses and estimate difference-in-differences models that compare treated and untreated cohorts across high- and low-construction departments. An additional preschool seat per child increases post-kindergarten schooling by about 0.5 years, raising the probability of completing secondary school by 11.9 percentage points and of attaining any post-secondary education by 7.1 percentage points. For women, access to the program also reduces fertility: an additional seat lowers the number of live births per woman by 0.20. Across several checks using cohort sizes, household composition, province-of-birth restrictions, and direct migration measures, we find little evidence consistent with systematic selective migration, suggesting that migration is unlikely to be a major source of bias in our estimates. Our results show little impact on labor-market outcomes at the census date, consistent with beneficiaries still being in school or in the early stages of their careers. A benefit-cost analysis based on the estimated schooling gains, standard Mincer returns, and observed construction and operating costs yields a benefit-cost ratio of about 11 and an internal rate of return of 13\%. Our findings show that universal at-scale pre-primary expansions in middle-income countries can generate sizable improvements in human capital and demographic outcomes at relatively low fiscal cost.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了阿根廷大规模公立学前教育扩张的长期效应。1993年至1999年间，联邦政府资助新建了针对基线入学率低且贫困程度高的地区的学前教育教室，新增约18.6万个学位。我们将教室建设的行政记录与四次人口普查数据相关联，采用双重差分模型比较高建设密度与低建设密度地区中受政策影响与未受影响的群体。每增加一个儿童学前教育学位，可使幼儿园后的受教育年限提高约0.5年，高中毕业概率提升11.9个百分点，接受高等教育的概率提升7.1个百分点。对女性而言，该政策还降低了生育率：每增加一个学位可使每位女性的活产数减少0.20。通过使用队列规模、家庭构成、出生省份限制及直接迁移指标等多项检验，我们未发现系统性选择性迁移的显著证据，表明迁移不太可能成为估计偏差的主要来源。结果显示，该政策在普查时点对劳动力市场影响甚微，这与受益者仍处于在校或职业生涯早期阶段的情况相符。基于估算的教育收益、标准明瑟回报率以及实际建设与运营成本进行的成本收益分析表明，收益成本比约为11，内部收益率为13%。本研究表明，中等收入国家大规模普及学前教育能以相对较低的财政成本显著提升人力资本与人口结构指标。

title: Industrial clusters in the long run: Evidence from Million-Rouble plants in China
title_zh: 长期视角下的产业集群：来自中国百万卢布工厂的证据
title_primary: 长期视角下的产业集群：来自中国百万卢布工厂的证据
title_secondary: Industrial clusters in the long run: Evidence from Million-Rouble plants in China
authors: Stephan Heblich, Marlon Seror, Hao Xu, and Yanos Zylberberg
official: 官方在线 2026-07-14 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the impact of large, successful manufacturing plants on other local producers in China, focusing on “Million-Rouble Plants” built in the 1950s during a brief alliance with the U.S.S.R. The ephemeral geopolitical situation and the locations of allied and enemy airbases provide exogenous variation in plant siting. We find a boom-and-bust pattern: Counties hosting these plants were 80% more productive than control counties in 1982 but 20% less productive by 2010. This decline reflects the performance of local establishments, which exhibit low productivity, limited innovation, and high markup. Specialization hindered spillovers, preventing the emergence of new clusters and local entrepreneurship.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了中国大型成功制造工厂对其他本地生产者的影响，重点关注20世纪50年代中苏短暂结盟期间建设的“百万卢布工厂”。短暂的地缘政治局势以及盟军与敌军空军基地的位置为工厂选址提供了外生变异。我们发现了一种“繁荣-萧条”模式：1982年，拥有这些工厂的县的生产率比对照组县高出80%，但到2010年却低了20%。这一下降反映了本地企业的表现，这些企业呈现出低生产率、有限创新和高加价的特点。专业化阻碍了溢出效应，阻止了新集群的形成和本地创业精神的发展。

title: What boundary delineation reveals about island evolutionary governance: Multi-level power brokerage in Réunion National Park
title_zh: 边界划定揭示的岛屿演化治理：留尼汪国家公园的多层级权力中介
title_primary: 边界划定揭示的岛屿演化治理：留尼汪国家公园的多层级权力中介
title_secondary: What boundary delineation reveals about island evolutionary governance: Multi-level power brokerage in Réunion National Park
authors: Salwa Aabid, Damien Deschamps, Erwann Lagabrielle
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study analyses the creation of La Réunion National Park (2002–2007) as a strategic and competitive political process embedded within a formal conservation planning framework. Drawing on Evolutionary Governance Theory (EGT), it shows how boundary delineation functioned as a governance instrument that reconfigured power relations between the French state and the Regional Council within a post-colonial, multi-level European outermost context marked by socio-environmental vulnerability and claims for regional autonomy. Combining GIS-based spatial analysis, archival research, and semi-structured interviews, the study traces the co-evolution of actors, institutions, discourses, knowledge, and material instruments throughout the park’s spatial planning process. Results, structured along five EGT analytical axes, indicate that boundary delineation constituted a strategic governance process rather than a purely technical exercise. Environmental planning emerged as a political arena in which power relations between the French state and the Regional Council were renegotiated. Scientific expertise and digital tools played a central role in legitimising decisions. Simultaneously, they contributed to filtering and hierarchising competing territorial claims. Participatory processes were formally inclusive but tightly managed, enabling consultation without substantially altering predefined outcomes and resulting in limited boundary changes. Finally, despite stated autonomy-oriented objectives, environmental planning contributed to the production of new social and spatial inequalities, highlighting the ambivalent role of conservation policies in island governance: ensuring both protection and external territorial control. More broadly, the study demonstrates how conservation planning operates as a governance instrument that shapes and reveals land values and power distribution. These findings suggest that boundary delineation should be explicitly treated as a political and governance instrument, requiring greater transparency, stronger accountability, and more substantive inclusion of local actors to avoid reinforcing existing power asymmetries in spatial planning.
abstract_zh: 本研究分析了留尼汪国家公园（2002–2007年）的创建过程，将其视为嵌入正式保护规划框架中的战略性与竞争性政治进程。基于演化治理理论（EGT），研究揭示了边界划定如何作为一种治理工具，在面临社会-环境脆弱性与区域自治诉求的后殖民、多层级欧洲最外围地区，重构法国国家与地区议会之间的权力关系。通过结合地理信息系统空间分析、档案研究与半结构化访谈，本研究追溯了公园空间规划过程中行动者、制度、话语、知识与物质工具的协同演化。依据EGT五大分析维度呈现的结果表明，边界划定构成了一种战略性治理过程，而非纯粹的技术性操作。环境规划成为法国国家与地区议会重新协商权力关系的政治场域。科学专业知识与数字工具在决策合法化中发挥核心作用，同时亦对相互竞争的领土诉求进行筛选与等级化。参与过程形式上具有包容性，但受到严格管控，允许协商却未实质性改变预设结果，仅导致有限的边界调整。最终，尽管以自治为导向的目标被明确表述，环境规划却催生了新的社会与空间不平等，凸显了保护政策在岛屿治理中的矛盾角色：既确保保护，又强化外部领土控制。更广泛而言，本研究揭示了保护规划如何作为塑造并反映土地价值与权力分配的治理工具。这些发现表明，边界划定应被明确视为政治与治理工具，需要更高的透明度、更强的问责机制以及更实质性的地方行动者参与，以避免在空间规划中强化既有的权力不对称。

title: Hemp Cultivation and Crop Diversification: Implications for Ecosystem Services in Kentucky
title_zh: 大麻种植与作物多样化：对肯塔基州生态系统服务的影响
title_primary: 大麻种植与作物多样化：对肯塔基州生态系统服务的影响
title_secondary: Hemp Cultivation and Crop Diversification: Implications for Ecosystem Services in Kentucky
authors: Yunsun Park, Seong D. Yun, Brandy E. Phipps, Tyler Mark, Craig Schluttenhofer
abstract: This study examines the ecosystem benefits of expanding hemp cultivation by assessing its impact on crop diversity. Using scenario‐based simulations and fixed‐effect panel regressions with county‐level data in Kentucky, we find that increased hemp acreage tends to enhance crop diversity, improving water quality and bird diversity. While agricultural policies aimed at small‐scale farmers align with improving farm profitability, broader ecological benefits may remain limited unless they reach a sufficient scale. Our findings suggest that hemp‐induced crop diversification can generate measurable non‐market economic benefits through improvements in water quality and bird diversity, highlighting the need for practical and proactive policy measures that promote smallholder participation.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过评估工业大麻种植对作物多样性的影响，探讨其带来的生态系统效益。基于肯塔基州县级数据的场景模拟与固定效应面板回归分析发现，工业大麻种植面积的增加倾向于提升作物多样性，进而改善水质与鸟类多样性。尽管面向小规模农户的农业政策与提升农场盈利能力的目标相契合，但若未达到足够规模，其更广泛的生态效益可能仍十分有限。研究结果表明，工业大麻引致的作物多样化可通过水质改善与鸟类多样性提升产生可量化的非市场经济效益，这凸显了制定切实可行且积极主动的政策措施以促进小农户参与的必要性。

title: The relationship between pesticides and risk in apple production
title_zh: 农药与苹果生产风险的关系
title_primary: 农药与苹果生产风险的关系
title_secondary: The relationship between pesticides and risk in apple production
authors: M Casati, L Arata, A Varacca, P Sckokai
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine how pesticide expenditure relates to the probability distribution of yield and revenue per hectare in apple production in northern Italy. Using a flexible moment-based approach, we find that pesticide expenditure is negatively associated with downside risk in yield and revenue, whereas late frosts are positively associated with downside risk in yield. Sensitivity analyses show that mean-equation estimates are robust to unobserved confounders, while negative semi-variance models are less robust overall. Only the pesticide–expected outcome relationship appears plausibly causal. Therefore, conclusions about pesticides as risk-increasing or risk-decreasing inputs should be made with caution.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了意大利北部苹果生产中农药支出与每公顷产量及收益概率分布之间的关系。采用灵活的基于矩的方法，我们发现农药支出与产量和收益的下行风险呈负相关，而晚霜则与产量的下行风险呈正相关。敏感性分析表明，均值方程估计对未观测到的混杂因素具有稳健性，而负半方差模型整体稳健性较弱。只有农药与预期结果之间的关系似乎具有合理的因果性。因此，关于农药作为风险增加或风险减少投入的结论应谨慎得出。

title: Business travel, institutions, and economic complexity
title_zh: 商务旅行、制度与经济复杂性
title_primary: 商务旅行、制度与经济复杂性
title_secondary: Business travel, institutions, and economic complexity
abstract: While international knowledge transfer drives structural transformation, the diffusion of tacit knowledge—the complex skills and procedures essential for sophisticated production—remains constrained by the need for face-to-face interaction. This paper identifies outbound business travel as a distinct channel for overcoming this friction. Exploiting a panel of 113 countries (1995–2020) and a System GMM framework to address endogeneity, I document a robust positive association between business travel and economic complexity. I show that this relationship is conditional on domestic political institutions: the returns to travel are amplified in inclusive, open political environments but vanish in highly centralized systems. Furthermore, I find evidence of diminishing marginal returns, suggesting that the benefits of travel moderate as connectivity channels saturate. I conclude that inclusive institutions function as a critical “absorptive filter” mechanism, enabling the tacit knowledge acquired abroad to translate effectively into national productive capabilities.
abstract_zh: 尽管国际知识转移推动着结构性转型，但隐性知识——复杂生产所需的关键技能与流程——的传播仍受限于面对面互动的需求。本文指出，出境商务差旅是克服这一摩擦的独特渠道。基于113个国家1995-2020年的面板数据，并采用系统GMM框架处理内生性问题，本文证实商务差旅与经济复杂度之间存在稳健的正向关联。研究表明，这一关系受国内政治制度调节：在包容开放的政治环境中，差旅的回报效应被放大，但在高度集权体制下则完全消失。此外，本文发现边际回报递减的证据，表明随着连通渠道趋于饱和，差旅收益将逐步减弱。结论指出，包容性制度作为关键的"吸收过滤"机制，能够使海外获取的隐性知识有效转化为国家生产能力。
